ordinary_change_requirements: observed changed paths exactly bound to one RepoChangeEnvelope
repo profile resolves each changed artifact from the protected base
required Garden modules are not silently omitted
material code/workflow/config changes carry source obligation references
authority_ref resolves from protected base authority registry
Compare/DO_NOTHING and typed Reason are present for material changes
AI-assisted work carries ExactReviewBinding and AIIndependenceAssessment
constitutional_rule: A change touching constitutional_paths cannot be authorized by request-supplied booleans or by the changed registry/policy itself. The change gate derives the tier from the protected base and requires an applicable protected-base human approval or sufficient trusted independent review. The one-time d42f31b bootstrap is limited to HUMAN-APPROVAL-GSL-FULL-COMPLIANCE-2026-09-13.
canonical_rule: Published Garden v15.5 source files are immutable in place. Canonical successor promotion is outside repository-agent authority and remains human-controlled.
documentation_rule: Purely explanatory documentation may be source-obligation-exempt only when it does not alter normative semantics, authority, policy, executable behavior or release claims; the envelope must explicitly classify that exemption.
protected_base_rule: Authority, policy, source-obligation and approval claims used to admit a change resolve from the PR base commit. Head changes cannot enlarge their own admission authority.
